Results.ReviewText: BEST GRILL I HAVE EVER OWNED!!! Period!  End of review!
Results.Title: THE BEST!

Results.ReviewText: Great little grill! It’s our first grill and we didn’t want anything too big. We like that the sides fold down. It’s easy to store. It was easy to build. The only thing that’s wrong is some of the black paint is coming off of the grill grate. Which I don’t think is normal.
Results.Title: Our first grill

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill.  It gets very hot, cooks food beautifully, and is easy to clean.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: Starts easily and I like how propane tank is behind door. Beautiful grill. Cooks very nicely!
Results.Title: Great grill

Results.ReviewText: The grill is idea for a family of three. It’s also large enough for large cookouts for 8 or more. Set up is easy. Mobility around the lanai is simple. Ignition is a breeze. The heavy duty grates are easy to clean and the temperature range is fantastic. It’s easy to sear meet and or keep food warm on indirect heat. Very glad I decided on a Weber. Would recommend this grill to family and friends.
Results.Title: Easy to use high performance grill

Results.ReviewText: Easy to use. Very dependable. Went together easily.
Results.Title: Love it

Results.ReviewText: Awesome little grill. Lots of room for a 2-burner, and cooks great.
Results.Title: Great grill!

Results.ReviewText: Having moved to a rural area with no natural gas, we purchased this smaller propane grill after having a gas Weber for years. Love the quality but, like many others, the grill came with a bent bottom panel. We managed to assemble the unit and thought we’d have to live with the bent panel. I had trouble registering the grill and when I called customer support for help, they not only did the registration for me, but also sent me a new bottom panel.
Results.Title: Same Great Quality

Results.ReviewText: Great grill! Perfect size for my back patio. Always reliable and easy to use.
Results.Title: Dependable Grill

Results.ReviewText: It was disappointing that we saw the exact same grill at Ace Hardware for $150 less than we paid directly from the Weber website.
Results.Title: Hot

Results.ReviewText: Excellent two burner grill, there is only three in our household, a two burner grill is good for us, and Weber is a company that spells quality, I also have owned Weber before and would rather pay a little more, for a quality-trouble free grill
Results.Title: Excellent Grill for small family

Results.ReviewText: Great little bbq, easy to ignite, heats up fast, easy to control temperature and clean up is a charm
Results.Title: Happy griller

Results.ReviewText: I had a Spirit E-210 before. It fits a two-person household who might entertain a small group. It gets very hot which allows me to sear the meat and keep in the juices and flavor. Having two burners helps me when I want one item to be more well done. I can easily manage the heat level from one side to the other.
Results.Title: Perfect two burner stove for small gatherings.

Results.ReviewText: This is a compact barbecue for small spaces and suits all of our needs.
Results.Title: Compact and Efficient

Results.ReviewText: This is one of the better Weber grills I’ve had over the years. The greats are wonderful because the meat does not stick and you get a nice char the way you like it also maintains the heat at a level that you’re looking for so your meat comes out exactly how you like it
Results.Title: Best Weber grill ever

Results.ReviewText: I’ve used the Grill 4 times now, seems prone to flare up with only 2 burners, also cools down rather quickly when lid is raised, The grill grates have extremely large gaps for food to fall through, I should of looked at it more closely when purchasing, my mistake. I’m getting used to using it now but I need to work on temperature control when cooking multiple items.
Results.Title: Cooking with Kevin

Results.ReviewText:
I bought this BBQ a month ago and it really works well. I was surprised how quickly the grill heats up.
There is just the wife and I so I didn't need a big grill and only bought the 2 burner one. It was easy to assemble and use right away. I was missing a few washers and Weber sent some replacement washers right away. Now that is customer service.
So far very happy with the purchase.
Results.Title: Great BBQ

Results.ReviewText: Thank you for making a small sized grill. It is perfect for the two of us. I've had Weber products for the last 30 years. I'm looking forward to many great meals on our latest Weber. We named it Bernie.
Results.Title: Happy

Results.ReviewText:
Love my Weber; but.....the side hooks should have been designed with a bit more curve or hook, and not the simple "L" shape so that your spatula and such can still hang on the folding side tables when down. Tools hang great when side tables are up, but won't hold when folded down?
     Yes! There's still lots of height,  almost 2 feet, to hang tools, and the cover still fits fine. I've emailed multiple times and submitted ample pictures holding a tape measure and all that already, but it's tough to find a Weber person to get email's to that suggested an engineering modification. 
   A small change in the plastic molded side covers adding a  slight modification to the hooks would solve this? Hey, it's only a suggestion,  but I'm surely not the only Weber owner to notice this and immediately disappointed? Thanks
Results.Title: Engineering flaw?

Results.ReviewText: Love this grill. The grates are top notch plus you can order a separate griddle grate.  Could not be more pleased with quality and the build
Results.Title: Buy it.  It is built smarter

Results.ReviewText: Redesigned back panel is too short, cabinet and grease trap now completely open to the elements. Another example of shrinkflation, cutting 2/3 of the sheet metal to save 50 cents and charging you $100 more for the privilege
Results.Title: Getting less grill for more money

Results.ReviewText: This is a great grill.  Heats up very fast, cooks evenly.  Easy to attach propane tank and really like the tank fill indicator.  Would recommend even though a little pricey.
Results.Title: Great Grill

Results.ReviewText: I haven’t had a grill for years. They never lasted long and they never lit right. I vowed to get one this year! I researched grills and decided on the Weber Spirit II 210 grill.i am so happy with my choice! It is so easy to operate! I love it so much!
Results.Title: Love my new grill!

Results.ReviewText:
It is my quick go to grille I use for every day. I have 3 other Weber grilles a genesis, performer and a Q.
It is smaller which is perfect for a small group. And fits on my lanai
Results.Title: Go to Grille

Results.ReviewText: Weber is always THEE BEST.  Never will let u down!
Results.Title: The Best

Results.ReviewText: This is my second Spirit E-210 gas grill. I liked the first better because the back side was completely covered.
Results.Title: Spirit E-210

Results.ReviewText: Great grill for small family,  can't wait to use the rotisserie you can get for it
Results.Title: Small family grilling

Results.ReviewText: I love this grill!  It is the perfect size for my patio and for 2 people.  It could easily do 4 people.  I love the thermostat and it gets really hot for cleaning or searing steaks/meat.
Results.Title: Great little grill

Results.ReviewText: I was considering a cheaper brand but went with weber because of build quality and features. So far very impressed. Easy clean up and extremely easy to use
Results.Title: Impressive gas grill

Results.ReviewText: No back on cabinet like my 15year old previous model. Returned to Lowes ,and bought slightly more expensive Spirit 310 3 burner model.  Both grilled well,but I wanted a closed cabinet to keep out critters and bugs since we live near a large woods. Found out Weber stopped putting backs on these models this year when I called Customer Service,( though they appear in diagrams online and assembly instructions,and in photos) . Apparently, back panels are arriving in Aug and Weber supposedly is sending one to me then
Results.Title: Back cabinet panels missing

Results.ReviewText: Top notch little grill.  Too bad the stainless steel surfaces are difficult to keep clean.
Results.Title: Built to last

Results.ReviewText: I’d rate this grill at 5 stars except for one thing: I’m 5’2” tall and cannot lift the lid when grilling without going to the side of the grill.  In addition, the handle is warm/hot to the touch near the sides.
Results.Title: Not for shorter people

46110001.Description:
Taste the difference a Spirit will make in your life. With features such as porcelain enameled, cast-iron cooking grates that retain even heat, you’re guaranteed the best tasting food. It’s built to last with a cookbox that helps prevent rusting and peeling, and conveniently equipped with six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools. If that wasn’t enough, the low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system takes the hassle out of cooking. Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.


• Durable, easy-to-clean porcelain-enamel cast iron grates.

• Porcelain-enameled finish helps prevent rusting and pealing.

• Six tool hooks for easy accessibility of grilling tools.

• Low maintenance and easy-to-clean grease management system.

• 360 square inches of main grilling space.


 This product requires assembly.
